continuity_note: Continuity counts checks with estimate age under 0.5 s. At 0.5 s measurement delay it is near zero by definition; this is a property of the pre-registered metric.
design_choices: 20 s mission duration: The unknown drone flies at 3 m/s across the 60 m venue, so 20 s covers the whole crossing and skimming pass (zone edge at x = 20 to 40 m, t = 6.7 to 13.3 s) and about 6.7 s of the loiter circle (it starts circling at 11.3 s).
The preregistration gives no duration, so 20 s is recorded as a runner design choice.
Mission change before any full run (prereg Addendum D): an estimate older than 1.0 s cannot raise or hold an alert.
deviations: Observer post check uses horizontal displacement (< 0.5 m), not 3-D displacement, because a failsafe landing drops 12 m straight down; 3-D displacement and runs with an observer landing are reported per cell.

hand_check.delay_note: Alert latency does not grow with measurement delay in this scenario. The ground station predicts its constant-velocity estimate forward to the current time at every check, and every path enters the zone along a straight line at constant speed, so the forward prediction removes the delay. A manoeuvring drone would not be treated this way: the forward prediction would be wrong by the manoeuvre made during the delay. The hand check adds the delay because it assumes no forward prediction.

missed_alerts_and_observer_landings.note: A lost-link failsafe landing is straight down, so the observer never leaves its post sideways. A landed observer stops sending fixes, so monitoring from that post stops; when both observers have landed the ground station has no fresh fixes and cannot raise an alert.

physics_alert_equality.compared_on: same path, preset, measurement delay and seed

prediction: clean: latency about 0.25 to 0.4 s, no misses; skimming at 2 m outside with 0.5 m noise (fused about 0.35 m) gives a few percent false alerts at most (3 consecutive needed). Loss raises latency by about the mean gap; bursts raise it by about the burst length (0.5 s) and cut continuity; misses only on burst_30 at long delay.
